Role Overview
We are hiring a Mobile Developer to build and ship native or cross-platform apps. In this role, you will build user-facing mobile experiences using Swift, Kotlin, React Native, or Flutter. The ideal candidate has a strong taste for mobile UX and attention to performance.
Key Responsibilities

• Build and ship features for iOS (Swift, SwiftUI), Android (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose), or cross-platform (React Native, Flutter).

• Integrate REST or GraphQL APIs, push notifications, and deep linking.

• Optimize app performance, bundle size, and battery impact.

• Release apps through the App Store and Play Store.

• Collaborate closely with designers and backend engineers.

• Handle edge cases, offline states, and error handling gracefully.

Required Skills & Qualifications

• 2+ years shipping mobile apps in production.

• At least one app currently live on the App Store or Play Store.

• Strong proficiency in Swift, Kotlin, or React Native.

• Understanding of Apple Human Interface Guidelines or Material Design.

• Experience with mobile testing and debugging tools.

• Strong attention to detail and user experience.

Preferred Qualifications

• SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose, or Flutter production experience.

• Native bridge or platform channel work.

• Mobile CI/CD tools (Fastlane, Bitrise, EAS).

• Mobile AI integration (Core ML, MLKit, on-device LLMs).

• Experience with real-time features or complex animations.

What We Offer

• Remote and flexible work environment.

• Contract and full-time options available.

• Opportunity to ship apps used by real users.

• Collaborative and design-focused team.

• Learning opportunities across iOS, Android, and cross-platform stacks.

Equal Opportunity Employer
We hire based on skills and expertise. All qualified candidates are welcome regardless of background, experience, or prior employment history. Applications are reviewed solely on demonstrated technical ability and qualifications.
Apply Now!

Welcome to Love's: We're seeking a remote Application Developer III to join our Application Development team. This role operates as a fully proficient individual contributor, responsible for designing, developing, and enhancing mobile applications that improve customer experience, system reliability, and delivery efficiency.

The position partners with Product Managers, Business Analysts, QA engineers, and technical peers to translate business requirements into scalable, high-quality technical solutions. This role emphasizes Android mobile development and QA automation, leveraging modern DevOps practices and AI-enabled development tools to improve productivity, strengthen testing practices, and support consistent, reliable software delivery.

Job Functions

• Application Development & Delivery
• Design, develop, and enhance Android mobile applications in cloud-based and distributed environments
• Deliver scalable, maintainable, and high-quality code aligned to enterprise engineering standard
• Integrate mobile applications with backend services and RESTful APIs
• Troubleshoot and resolve complex defects, performance issues, and production incidents

Test Automation & Quality Engineering

• Design, implement, and maintain automated test suites (unit, integration, and UI)
• Improve release quality and confidence through automation and continuous testing practices
• Partner with QA to ensure strong test coverage and defect prevention strategies

DevOps & Continuous Delivery

• Contribute to CI/CD pipelines including build automation, testing, and deployment
• Support monitoring, observability, and production stability of mobile applications
• Apply secure coding practices and data protection standards

Technical Design & Collaboration

• Translate business requirements into technical solutions and implementation plans
• Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to design decisions within the team
• Collaborate cross-functionally in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including estimation and sprint planning
• Provide informal guidance and support to less experienced developers

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

• Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve code quality, testing efficiency, and delivery speed
• Identify and implement opportunities to improve development processes and engineering practices
• Stay current with mobile technologies, frameworks, and industry trends
• Supports broader team and enterprise goals by proactively contributing to initiatives outside of core responsibilities.

Experience And Qualifications

• 5+ years' experience 
• Experience using AI-assisted coding tools to improve developer efficiency and code quality 

Skills And Physical Demands

• Proficiency in Android development using Kotlin and/or Java
• Experience with mobile test automation frameworks
• Experience delivering and supporting customer-facing mobile applications
• Experience integrating mobile applications with RESTful APIs and backend services
• Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and DevOps practices
• Strong understanding of software design patterns and engineering best practices
• Ability to collaborate effectively within Agile/Scrum teams
• Familiarity with AI-powered developer tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Tabnine, or similar)

Our Culture

Fueling customers' journeys since 1964, innovation leads the way for this family-owned and operated business headquartered in Oklahoma City. With nearly 40,000 team members, travel stops are the core business along with products and services that provide value for professional drivers, fleets, traveling public, RVers, alternative energy and wholesale fuel customers. Giving back to communities and an inclusive workplace are hallmarks of the award-winning culture.

Love's is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Veterans encouraged to apply.
